card.name: Names and contact details before a proper noun
card.fires_on: Punctuation or name parts inside bylines, author lists, addresses and phone numbers, right before a surname, place name or number group is expected. Seen at commas after a person's name, hyphens in phone numbers, and first names.

modes.label: Bylines and author names
modes.description: A comma or first name in a list of authors or credits, just before the next name.
modes.example: Susan C. Kim, MD - Pediatrics & John Pope<<,>> MD - Pediatrics

modes.label: Phone numbers and addresses
modes.description: The hyphen inside a phone number or a street word in an address.

modes.label: Titles of works and cases
modes.description: A word inside a title or case name, before the rest of a proper name.
modes.example: Parents Involved in<< Community>> Schools v. Seattle School District No.

card.writes: It favors proper-name pieces such as place and person names, mostly non-English ones.
card.plain: It fires on names and contact details, at the spot just before a surname, place or number comes next.
